stage: post-delivery hotfix — login impossible from platform preview
reported: User: не можам да се најавам (cannot log in) via the version-card preview
rootCause: Session cookie was SameSite=Lax without Secure. The platform preview embeds the app cross-site (iframe over HTTPS); browsers never send Lax cookies on cross-site fetch, so login succeeded (200 + Set-Cookie) but the next auth.me arrived without the cookie and the SPA bounced back to /login.
fix: api/routers/auth.ts — isSecureReq() detects HTTPS (x-forwarded-proto / req.url); secure requests get 'SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned' (CHIPS), plain-http dev keeps SameSite=Lax. Applied to login + logout cookie writers.

checks.cmd: curl http login with x-forwarded-proto: https
